`node total.js 2 3` now prints 5. The sum started at 1 instead of 0, so every total came out one too high. I changed that one character on `total.js:2` and left it uncommitted.

Route: Bug fix playbook. figure-it-out skip: this is a one-line fix done in one session.

**Root cause.** The `reduce` on line 2 used 1 as its starting value. A sum has to start at 0.

**Evidence.** With no arguments the script printed 1, which can only be the starting value. `node total.js 4` printed 5. Every input came out exactly one too high, so the way the script reads its arguments is not the problem.

**Fix.**
```diff
-console.log(nums.reduce((sum, n) => sum + n, 1));
+console.log(nums.reduce((sum, n) => sum + n, 0));
```

**Before and after.** This is the terminal output from each run.

```
6  (2 3)         5  (2 3)
1  (no args)     0  (no args)
5  (4)           4  (4)
                 6  (1 2 3)
```
